description: FR-M36-05 capability registry: the single source of truth for tiering. Every capability is owned by exactly one tier (flight-recorder | governor | orchestra), and every bus method belongs to exactly one capability. The sidecar refuses RPCs owned by a disabled tier with TIER_DISABLED; the extension host filters commands and views by the same registry (X-28). Not-yet-built tiers register their capabilities with stub RPC names so the mechanism is proven before the features land. The generator (scripts/generate-bus-types.mjs) emits TIERS, DEFAULT_ENABLED_TIERS and CAPABILITIES constants into both shared/ts/bus-types.ts and shared/py/bus_types.py, and synthesises the TierName type from x-tiers.tiers.

capabilities.description: Sidecar lifecycle: handshake, heartbeat, shutdown, health. Always enabled — the base tier cannot be turned off.

Deterministic git-native attribution: line blame, unified-diff attribution for worktree/staged/ranges, tree-sitter line→symbol naming, human-vs-agent change heuristics (FR-M33-02 subset, FR-M35-02 aid; F0 Workstream C tasks 13–15). Zero model calls (FR-M36-07).
Append-only provenance ledger, query API and Chain Viewer backend (FR-M10-01/02/07/08/09/12, FR-M11-01..05; F0 Workstream B).

External-agent observers (FR-M35-02/03/08, X-29, NFR-32; F0 Workstream D tasks 17-22): session observation via the documented fallback chain with confidence downgrade, X-29 session detection behind the Crown, and observer health. Zero model calls (FR-M36-07); one-way isolation (SEC-27).

Git provenance trailers (FR-M36-03, D23; F0 Workstream E tasks 23-24): the opt-in commit-msg hook appending `Meridian-Ledger: <seq range>`, pending-commit linkage records keyed by staged content hash, hook lifecycle (install/status/remove), and cross-vendor agent-identity trailer parsing into attribution records. Zero model calls (FR-M36-07).
Policy gates over external and hosted agent work (FR-M12-01; F1). Stub RPC until F1 lands it.
Steer and clarifying questions into running sessions (FR-M25-01/02; F1). Stub RPC until F1 lands it.
Trust and rejection analytics (FR-M37-*; F0 subset/F1 full). Stub RPC until it lands.
The six canonical loops (FR-M4-03; F3). Stub RPCs until F3 lands them.

CapabilityDefinition.description: One capability in the registry (FR-M36-05). rpcMethods are the bus methods the capability owns.
